title: Review Rarely Beats the Stronger Model: Separating Verification from Capability Transfer in LLM Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2610.15897v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Qwen3-8B reviewing Llama-3.1-8B in math adds 33.2 points, yet Qwen3-8B alone is 6.4 points more accurate than the result. Reviewing another model's answer is usually judged by its gain over the generator. We show that this confuses verification, which adds accuracy beyond either model alone, with capability transfer, where a stronger reviewer supplies answers it could have given on its own. Measured against the stronger model alone, across 48 pairs of 12 open-weight models (3B to 72B) in math, knowledge, code and reasoning, review beats it in only 9 of 96 review directions, and does worse the larger the capability gap. The reason is anchoring: the reviewer mostly follows the generator, discarding its own correct answers. Review costs 2.6 to 2.8 times as much as the stronger model alone, while a selector using the same two calls is 2.7 to 4.2 points more accurate than review and cheaper. Studies of verification should report the stronge

translated_title: 评审很少胜过更强的模型：在大语言模型流水线中区分验证与能力迁移
translated_abstract: 在数学任务中，Qwen3-8B 对 Llama-3.1-8B 的答案进行评审可带来 33.2 分的提升，但 Qwen3-8B 单独作答的准确率反而比这一结果高出 6.4 分。通常人们以评审相对于生成器的增益来评判其价值，我们指出这种评判方式混淆了验证（即带来超越任一单模型单独表现的准确率提升）与能力迁移（即更强的评审者只是提供了它本来就能自己给出的答案）。以更强模型单独表现为基准，在 12 个开源权重模型（3B 至 72B）的 48 组配对、涵盖数学、知识、代码和推理任务的实验中，96 个评审方向里仅有 9 个方向上评审胜过更强模型，且能力差距越大表现越差。其根源在于锚定效应：评审者大多跟随生成器的答案，丢弃了自己原本正确的答案。评审的成本是单独使用更强模型的 2.6 至 2.8 倍，而使用同样两次调用的选择器不仅准确率比评审高 2.7 至 4.2 分，而且成本更低。
tldr: 论文揭示了 LLM 评审流水线中“验证”与“能力迁移”的本质区别——评审很少超越更强的单模型、因锚定效应丢弃自身正确答案且成本更高，而简单的答案选择器是更准确又便宜的替代方案。
